input: GPU 없는 t3.medium급 서버에서 한국어 음성인식을 로컬로 돌리려고 해. 외부 API가 실패할 때 쓰는 폴백이고, 정확도는 CER로 판단할 거야.
outputs: The model is designed for Korean speech recognition tasks, optimized for deployment on low-resource environments such as a t3.medium server without GPU. It supports Korean as its primary language and is capable of achieving competitive performance in local inference scenarios. With a parameter count of approximately 50 million, it strikes a balance between efficiency and accuracy. The model is particularly useful as a fallback solution when external APIs fail, ensuring continuous operation. Its strengths lie in its robustness and adaptability to various acoustic conditions, making it suitable for real-time applications. Performance is evaluated using Character Error Rate (CER) as the primary metric.
